name: bedrockgateway
description: DNS and Minecraft Bedrock proxy gateway in Node.js for consoles (Nintendo Switch, Xbox, PlayStation)

scripts.sonar: npm run test:coverage && npm run sonar:scan
scripts.sonar:scan: docker run --rm --network host -u $(id -u):$(id -g) -v "$PWD:/usr/src:z" -e SONAR_HOST_URL=http://127.0.0.1:9000 -e SONAR_TOKEN sonarsource/sonar-scanner-cli
scripts.sonar:issues: curl -s -u "$SONAR_TOKEN:" "http://127.0.0.1:9000/api/issues/search?componentKeys=bedrockgateway&resolved=false&ps=500" | jq '.issues[] | {severity, type, message, file: .component, line}'

author: ripper2hl
